title: StandaloneExecutionTask
description: Governing schema for StandaloneExecutionPrompt editable input and parameter payloads.

prompt_id.description: Unique identifier for this prompt instance.

prompt_template_id.description: Identifier of the base prompt template (SEP-01 through SEP-25).

repository.description: Canonical GitHub repository name, e.g. reallaksh19/Common

topic.description: Broad disciplinary topic (e.g. Motion, Thermodynamics, Algebra).

subtopic.description: Specific atomic subtopic (e.g. Relative Motion, Redox Reactions).

engineering_depth.description: Depth tier: FOUNDATION (CBSE Board), STANDARD (JEE Main), RESEARCH (JEE Advanced/Olympiad).

learner_state.description: Cognitive diagnostic state of the learner.

web_research_allowed.description: Whether the agent is permitted to consult external web sources.

local_question_banks.description: Path to local assessment corpora or 'DISCOVER_FROM_REPOSITORY'.

write_mode.description: Execution mode: read-only audit/analysis or file-writing implementation.

expected_scope.description: Optional hints outlining candidate scope boundaries.

explicit_exclusions.description: Mandatory out-of-scope concepts to prevent scope creep.

subject_profile_version.description: Version of the subject profile used during compilation.

schema_registry_version.description: Version of the schema registry referenced.
